sources.title: Realisations of elliptic operators on compact manifolds with boundary
sources.supplied_format: Original author LaTeX, gzip single-file container

uses.conditions: Original smooth elliptic differential operator of positive integer order between common-rank complex bundles on a compact manifold with smooth boundary; inward D_t=-i partial_t convention.
uses.correspondence: Complete receiving jump, every layer trace, ordered residue matrix and both smooth-kernel remainder proofs preserved. Source approximate-projector theorem is cited there, not proved in full.
Exact ordinary/D trace conjugation, complete scalar convention counterexamples, holomorphic polynomial residue matrix, row degree, antipodal rank exceptions and ordered resolvent sign.

uses.conditions: Original circle Fourier multiplier Lambda=(1+D_y^2)^(1/2), all four constant matrix coefficients and low/high Sobolev component orders retained.
uses.correspondence: Complete compactness iff c=0 for the indicated model; no identification with an arbitrary exact Cauchy graph space or actual projector is assumed.

ai_contribution.scope: Independent proof exposition, source convention comparison, complete counterexamples, reproducible figure and writer self-check
